pages.text: With the crop lifecycle enabled, crops no longer grow by vanilla random ticks.$(br2)Instead, every crop advances $(bold)once per MC day$(), at the daily settlement right after $(info)6:00 AM$().$(br2)Each day, a crop gains $(thing)1 / (days to mature)$() of progress.

pages.title: What this means
pages.text: A crop configured to mature in 3 days will be fully grown on the third settlement after planting.$(br2)Growth happens for all $(bold)loaded chunks$() at once, so fields far away still grow while you are near them.$(br2)Unloaded chunks do not advance; they resume from their saved state when loaded again.

pages.title: Maturation days
pages.text: The number of days is shown on the seed's tooltip: $(info)Matures in X days$().$(br2)Each plant rolls a small random offset around that number, so a batch of crops does not all ripen on the same day.
